bullets: Developed front-end and back-end features for the GlycoData platform using HTML5, CSS, Python, JavaScript, Flask, and Django, resulting in faster database execution and lower UI latency.
Migrated and hosted application environments on AWS, implementing S3 for file management and rewriting background workflows to run efficiently on AWS Lambda.
Configured Dockerized application environments using Python and Java containers to establish repeatable developer environments and reduce localized deployment bugs by 20%.
Troubleshot complex runtime application bugs on the production server, using AWS CloudWatch and Pytest to isolate issues and decrease platform downtime by 15%.
Implemented secure coding and operational practices, applying fine-grained AWS IAM roles and authorization policies to protect user and system data assets.
